files.README.md:
# Thackmoor Fabrication - welding parameter sheets

The shop works from the parameter sheet issued for the process in use. Two issues are kept under `procedures/`, because some older work is still being inspected against the sheet it was made under.
files.procedures/weld-params-2023.md:
# Welding parameters - issue 3

Issued 4 September 2023. This issue applied to work carried out on or after 1 October 2023 and was withdrawn when the next issue took effect.

## Ranges

Mild steel, 4 mm to 12 mm: 185 A.
Stainless, 2 mm to 8 mm: 120 A.
files.procedures/weld-params-2026.md:
# Welding parameters - issue 6

Issued 12 January 2026. This issue applies to work carried out on or after 1 February 2026 and replaces every earlier issue from that date.

## Ranges

Mild steel, 4 mm to 12 mm: 175 A.
Stainless, 2 mm to 8 mm: 115 A.
files.docs/qa-notes.md:
# QA notes

Weld inspections are booked by the QA team and filed with the job pack when the job closes.
Films are kept for the period the customer contract sets.
